gui.discover.title: Discover
gui.discover.subtitle.idle: Find the applications installed on a host and add the ones you want
gui.discover.host.label: Host
gui.discover.nohost.title: Add a host to discover applications
gui.discover.nohost.body: Discover reads the list of installed applications from a Linux host over SSH. Add a host first.
gui.discover.note.title: Read-only.
gui.discover.note.body: Scanning lists the host’s installed applications over SSH. It starts nothing and changes nothing. An application is only added when you select it and choose Import selected; a re-scan never changes applications you already imported.
gui.discover.scanning.title: Scanning {host}…
gui.discover.scanning.body: Reading the installed applications over SSH. You can cancel at any time.
gui.discover.cancelled.title: Scan cancelled
gui.discover.cancelled.body: Nothing was changed. Choose Scan to try again.
gui.discover.empty.title: No applications found
gui.discover.empty.body: {host} reported no graphical applications. Waylauncher looks for desktop files under /usr/share/applications and the other XDG application folders.
gui.discover.error.keptOld: The list below is from the previous scan.
gui.discover.iconsError: Icons could not be loaded ({error}). Generated icons are shown instead.
gui.discover.importedAs: Already imported as {id}. Re-scans never change it.
gui.discover.toast.copied: Copied. Paste it in Terminal to verify the host key.
